introHtml: Custom business card magnets combine the practicality of a business card with the staying power of a refrigerator magnet. Unlike standard paper cards that get lost or tossed, these magnetic versions stick around kitchens, offices, and job sites, keeping your contact info visible for months. Available in standard business card size, they work well for real estate agents, contractors, and service providers who want repeat visibility. Choose from rounded corners or full-color printing to match your brand.
